description.default: Two-way Hongdou <-> SiYuan integration: citation hover preview, one-click rich-text bibliography copy, in-document citation panel, auto-maintained CSL bibliography, Word export with citations, cited-by lookup, citation graph index, per-note citation style, PDF annotations with colour semantics, and right-click "Send to SiYuan" from Hongdou.
description.zh_CN: 红豆 ↔ 思源 双向联动：引用悬停预览、一键复制富文本参考文献、本篇引用清单、正文引用自动生成 CSL 文末表、导出 Word（带引用与参考文献）、反向索引（谁引用了这篇）、引用图谱索引、每篇独立引用样式、PDF 批注颜色语义，以及在红豆里右键「发送到思源」自动落笔。
